description: This file defines a class LogcatConsoleActionsPostProcessor that customizes actions for the Android Logcat console view within an IDE, including adding a clear log action and modifying existing actions.

classes.name: LogcatConsoleActionsPostProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes and customizes console actions for Android Logcat within the IDE.

classes.name: ClearLogCatAction
classes.description: An action class that clears the logcat console when triggered.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Overrides the method to process and modify console actions for Logcat console.

methods.name: processActions
methods.description: Filters and reorders actions, adding a clear logcat action.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Enables or disables the clear logcat action based on console state.
